why: OpenCode 2's own vocabulary for the compaction hook, so a test of PAN's plugin checks the shape OpenCode documents, not the shape PAN assumed (doctrine 11 of /reality-check). The v1 hook `experimental.session.compacting` maps to `ctx.session.hook("compaction", ...)`; the event is `SessionContextHook & { result?: SessionCompactionResult }`, and OpenCode appends its summary prompt after hooks run.
